title: Signed native final-MLP contributions versus matched-cardinality deletion
hypothesis: Negative and positive native post-gating channel contributions can affect current native decisions differently from matched-cardinality randomly removed channels. A difference alone does not identify semantic function or useful improvement.
cases_source: Exact all96N41A cases,all8codingfamilies/two bindings and arithmetic/JSONretention. Development local measurement,not fresh confirmation. No case selected from outcomes.
positions: For EVERY original native response,zero-based first min(3,T) decisions. Saved IDs are teacher measurements only. No new response or free generation.
masks: At native down_proj input h,current last position only: negative h<0,positive h>0. Strict signed zeros neither. Remove means assign literal0 to those actual coordinates. For each case and step,random.Random(4501) and random.Random(4502) fixed permutations of all channels;prefix n_negative or n_positive respectively. Same two permutations reused for every case/step,not fitted. Both random sets exactcardinality but NOT magnitude or energy matched. Native sign values recomputed under identical original teacher inputs,prepatchhash exact baseline.
control_panels: For each case,baseline prefixK;identity clone-current prefixK;four mask prefixK,each immediately followed by native restoration prefixK. Fresh DynamicCache for every prefixpanel,original consumed IDs same. Original firstK fullFP32logits/argmax/rawcache hashes must exactly match saved N41native references. All edited rawK/V caches exact original sameinput;allother current/prefill positions exact;zero parameter assignments/gradients/optimizer;fullscopedstate before/after every case and observed terminal.
metrics: All5conditions/all96cases/all10families/allroles/allfirstKpoints: fullFP32logit/rawcache/nativeh/mask/editedh hashes,actualmaskcardinality and removedh squared energy (FP64),argmax nativewinner vsfixed bestother margin,nativewinner probability,relativefullvocabFP64L2/maxabs. Equal-case means after within-case pointmeans. No pvalues,winningmask/site selection,mediationfractions,individualmeaning,syntaxproof,generalcodinggain orspeed claim.
completeness: All96cases,all5conditions,and all281actual frozen firstK points plus every declared identity,restoration,state,lineage and counter witness are required. Interrupted or guard-failed panels are censored.
witness_scope: Host checks recorded hashes and metadata. It does not independently recompute the native activations,sign values,full logits or full pretrained parameter bytes.
edition: Reviewed prospective design. Native teacher IDs,prompts,worker,notebook and raw measurements remain private.
